newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Two Berjaya companies to be requoted on Dec 4.
newsitem.headline: Two Berjaya companies to be requoted on Dec 4.

text.p: The suspended stocks of Berjaya Group Bhd and Berjaya Industrial Bhd will be requoted on the main board of the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange (KLSE) on December 4.
Trading in the shares of two companies will resume at 0930 local time (0130 GMT) on Wednesday, the KLSE said in separate statements. The stocks were suspended on November 25.
Berjaya had proposed to divest a 32 percent stake in Berjaya Industrial Bhd to Linksun Avenue Sdn Bhd for a gross sum of 568.01 million ringgit.
